title: Draw noisy monthly counts as columns, with an average line through them.
rule: Use columns with a moving average for a monthly count that swings from month to month: each month a column from zero, the average a heavy line over them, preliminary months hatched and the average dashed where it includes one, and the latest month labeled with its status. Where the publisher gives a margin of error, say in a note which months pass it.
use_when: The reader asks how many were added or lost each month, and the trend matters more than any one month.

use_instead.when: A rate or a level that moves smoothly
The same count across many industries or places
A month has no figure at all

text: Each column shows one month as the survey counted it, and the average shows where the months are heading, so a single bad month reads as a dip, not a turn. A survey’s monthly figure carries error, and the note that says which drops pass the margin keeps a small swing from reading as news (Rule 14.9).
why.basis: Design judgment, from the chart system our founder and editor approved in November 2026

builders: Form columns-moving-average: node work/build/chart-kit/oa-chart.mjs build s14; encode.status marks preliminary months.
